values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/manisteeriverbridge ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Manistee River Bridge State Forest Campground, Crawford: 23 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in river access only (amenity table 'C'): a small deck behind site 3 and a grass canoe/kayak landing, both down stairs, at least 30 yards from parking (visitor/launch parking by site 16).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/manisteeriverbridge ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'; 'One is a small wooden deck behind site #3, and the other is a large grass landing perfect for launching canoes or kayaks. Both access points are down a set of stairs, so visitors should be aware that they will have to carry boats at least 30 yards'; 'parking within the campground adjacent to site #16') + amenity table (Boat ramp(R) OR carry-in access(C): 'C'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/manisteeriverbridge ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: '23 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use' (no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/manisteeriverbridge ('There are 23 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site.') + amenity table (23 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the main branch of the Manistee River, 7.8 mi NW of Grayling via M-72 and North Campground Road (Crawford County); managed by Hartwick Pines State Park. Brown, brook and rainbow trout; Lake Margrethe is 2 mi east. Paddlers can camp here but must carry boats and gear up stairs from the river. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 23 sites for tent/small/large trailers (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches. River access is carry-in only. Type 'rustic', ORV operation to trails 'no'; no equestrian wording. Note trimmed of field restatements.
